scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run start:dev"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix frontend run lint:fix && npm --prefix backend run lint:fix
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
